answer: Sybil resistance here is a widening spiral of bonded work. I first lock 290 spendable POA and publish a SHA-256 commitment to a one-time quill signing key. Over 33 hours I must deliver six terrace checkpoints, each 330 minutes later, each signed by a fresh HKDF child of that key and hashing the prior checkpoint. If I miss a checkpoint, reuse a child key, or break the hash chain, the bond is slashed; cloning myself therefore multiplies both locked capital and irrecoverable waiting time.
